label: 7a: a classified root error loses its code
old:
if errors.As(err, &e) {
		return &Error{Code: e.Code, Msg: what + ": " + e.Msg, Err: e.Err}
new:
if false && errors.As(err, &e) {
		return &Error{Code: e.Code, Msg: what + ": " + e.Msg, Err: e.Err}

label: 7b: the caller's deadline is not DeadlineExceeded
new:
case false && errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
		code = DeadlineExceeded

label: 7c: cancellation is not Aborted
new:
case false && errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
		code = Aborted

label: 7d: after a change is not Aborted
old:
case i > 0:
		return &Error{Code: Aborted, Msg: what + " (earlier ops applied; a retry converges)", Err: err}
new:
case false && i > 0:
		return &Error{Code: Aborted, Msg: what + " (earlier ops applied; a retry converges)", Err: err}
